output_text:
## Bottom line
**Not uniformly a “safe bet” across Salt Lake County right now.** The answer depends on the branch: **West Valley City** has the strongest current inspection signal (score **2** on 2026-02-24, with no critical item cited), and **West Jordan** is also relatively favorable (score **4** on 2026-03-19, no critical item cited). However, **Midvale** and **Riverton** each had a critical violation on their most recent inspection—Midvale scored **5** on 2026-01-21 and Riverton scored **8** on 2026-04-16—so I would not label the chain broadly as a safe bet without choosing location carefully.

## Visual analytics
Two charts accompany this answer:
1. **Most Recent Inspection Scores** compares the four Salt Lake County branches with matched inspection histories.
2. **Inspection-Score Trends** shows how scores have changed over time at the locations with available histories.

|---|---:|---:|---|---|
| West Valley City, 3715 Constitution Dr | 2026-02-24 | **2** | No | Best current inspection signal among the matched county locations. |
| West Jordan, 7785 Jordan Landing Blvd | 2026-03-19 | **4** | No | Reasonable option, though its score rose from 2 in September 2025. |
| Midvale, 7206 Union Park Ave | 2026-01-21 | **5** | **Yes** | Caution: no hand-drying provision at a hand sink was cited as critical. |
| Riverton, 12569 S Crossing Dr | 2026-04-16 | **8** | **Yes** | Strongest caution signal: a dirty ice bin was cited as critical. |

## Important context
All four matched Salt Lake County locations are highly reviewed—each has a **4.5** average Google rating and **2,281–4,588** reviews—but customer ratings do not override the latest inspection findings. Riverton has **9** cumulative critical violations and Midvale **6**, versus West Jordan **5** and West Valley City **2** in the available histories.

The search also found seven other Utah In-N-Out Burger listings without a matched Salt Lake County inspection record. A missing match is **not** evidence of a clean inspection history; county matching is available for only a small share of establishments overall (1.6%).

**Recommendation:** If you are choosing among these four, prefer **West Valley City**, with **West Jordan** as the next-best current option. Avoid treating **Midvale** or **Riverton** as inspection-based safe bets until a subsequent inspection shows the critical issues resolved.
